propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate developed the provider adapters and the retry scheduler in the development environment and ran load tests against the staging cluster with synthetic traffic at up to 15k messages a second.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the load-test report document the development work and the staging tests.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate wrote the runbook drafts and the hand-over notes for each release candidate, listing the staging cluster's differences and the open items for SRE.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the runbook draft document the artefacts.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate deployed service changes to production, ran the service at 40k messages a second, held a place on the on-call rota and handled production incidents such as delivery backlogs.
propositions.rationale: The resume places the candidate's work in the development environment and the staging cluster and deployments, on-call and incident handling with the SRE pair; her screen example was a staging load test.

expectedGap: The materials document development-environment work and staging load tests; they do not document the candidate deploying to production, holding an on-call place or handling a production incident.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the environment the resume names: development environment and staging cluster; deployments, on-call and production incidents belonged to the SRE pair.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate has ever held deployment rights or an on-call place for the service, and which production incident she handled.
